svg.title: Loomward: meaning, residency and permission kept apart (animated)
svg.desc: Animated loop: the owner grants one folder, native enumeration streams metadata only and refuses an offline file as unknown, the SQLite catalogue grows, and three separate threads form. A file gains Project and Finance meaning without its residency changing, and permission stays with no actor. A tier move is only simulated. An agent queries over the read-only MCP reference, and its delete request fails because no such tool exists.
svg.text: your files, understood. Nothing touched without you.
research prototype · reads and simulates · changes nothing on your machine

g.text: picked by you, not an agent

svg.text: no elevation · no-recall opens · unknown is not 0
agents get another view, never hands
You grant one folder in the native dialog. Agents never pick roots
Metadata only: duplicates share one identity, and an offline file stays unknown, not zero
The catalogue fills in SQLite, crash-safe
One file, three separate threads: it joins Project and Finance without moving
A tier move is only simulated. Nothing on the disk changes
An agent can search over the read-only MCP reference
…but there is no delete tool to call
